level.description: CC protection level, used only for general actions: default (default), normal (normal), strict (strict), or captcha (CAPTCHA challenge).

next_rules.description: Whether to continue to the next rule set for observe, allow, bot verification, or honeypot redirection actions. 0 indicates no; 1 indicates yes.

interval.description: Validity period for the block or allowlist action.

time_unit.description: Ban time unit for the block action method: day, hour, minute, or second. The white action method has no time unit and supports seconds only.

type.description: Verification type for the human verification action: cookie (Cookie verification), js (JS verification), or captcha (smart CAPTCHA).

cc.description: Whether to continue CC processing for allow or honeypot redirection actions. 0 skips processing; 1 continues processing.

waf.description: Whether to execute WAF for allow, allowlist, or honeynet redirection actions. 0 indicates do not execute; 1 indicates execute.

group_ids.description: Domain group IDs. The same action is applied to all domains in each domain group for the allowlist action.

protocol.description: Protocol used to request the honeypot server for the honeypot redirection action: http or https.

ip.description: Honeynet server IP for the honeynet diversion action.

port.description: Honeynet server port for the honeynet diversion action.

redirect_url.description: Redirect URL for the redirect action.
